_comment: HAND-AUTHORED. Never script-written. Extracted from cv/onepage/ONE-PAGE.tex L218-231.
`academic` is a list of LINES (each a list of institutions joined with '|') because the
grouping is a deliberate line-wrap, not a semantic grouping — keeping it explicit lets a
tailored CV drop an institution without the remaining ones reflowing unpredictably.
Ids are referenced as `collab:<id>` from an application manifest.
`role` records WHAT PART YILI PLAYED in an industry partnership — 'facilitator' (brokered
or initiated it) vs 'participant' (contributed to it, someone else convened it). It is not
rendered anywhere; it exists so a cover letter claiming 'I facilitated X' has a source in
the data instead of asserting it in prose. Omitted where the part played is not recorded.
`stage` similarly keeps an early partnership from being written up as a delivered result.
